pattern.description: After the cursor clicks the Notion logo, the scene cuts to a blue field where the Notion AI face badge pops in with a quick scale overshoot, then its line-drawn features shift into a new expression (brow lifts, eye moves) as it settles.
pattern.why_premium: The click-to-pop gives the AI mascot a character beat in a fraction of a second; the small expression change after the scale settles makes it feel alive without full character animation.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(badge, {scale: 0.8}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'back.out(2)'}).to(featurePaths, {morphSVG: nextExpression, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.inOut'}, '-=0.05') (or crossfade two feature SVGs if MorphSVG is unavailable).
build_hint.remotion: scale = spring({frame, fps, config: {mass: 1, stiffness: 260, damping: 14}}) mapped 0.8->1 (overshoot); features: interpolate path points or opacity crossfade between two expression SVGs over frames 6-12 with Easing.inOut(Easing.quad).

notes: Filmstrip frames are cropped at varying zoom, so the badge's real scale change versus crop framing is uncertain (camera move none; scale sum 1.44 is content-only). f25 is the hard cut from the white Notion-logo frame; a pop/click-like transient is visible on the spectrogram at ~1.17 s but no SFX candidate was provided. No pattern in the taxonomy covers a mascot expression change; logo_resolve is the nearest.
